summary: A golden item is a question with what you expect: the source pages, optional phrases, or a refusal. You build a validated loader that catches typos and contradictions, write the first five questions with expected sources, and learn hit@3, rank, MRR, refusal accuracy and pass as separate metrics.

items.text: Add golden.py, data/golden-5.jsonl and check_golden.py and match the line
Make a typo in an expected source and read the error
Write five questions of your own, opening every expected page
Write a refusal with a source and an answerable question with none, and read the errors
Write the tests and review your questions with the checklist
Play the Golden Set Check game to the end and see your score
